newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to achieve '96 budget deficit target - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain to achieve '96 budget deficit target - Montoro.

text.p: Spain is meeting its budget forecasts for 1996 and will achieve its deficit target of 4.4 percent of gross domestic product this year, Secretary of State for the Economy Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday.
"(The budget) is being carried out in line with established forecasts," he told parliament's budget commission. "We are heading towards the target of 4.4 percent of GDP."
Inflation, currently at 3.6 percent, could fall below three percent in the first months of next year, he added.
"It is possible for inflation to fall below three percent in the first quarter of 1997," he said.
The government hopes to bring inflation down to 2.6 percent for 1997 as a whole.
